extension.description: VS Code language support for Kisite.
config.pythonPath: Python executable used to run Kisite and parser diagnostics.
config.interpreterPath: Path to kisite.py. Leave empty to search parent directories of the active .kis file. ${workspaceFolder} is supported.
config.saveBeforeRun: Save the active Kisite file before running it.
config.diagnostics.enabled: Parse Kisite documents with the real Kisite parser and show syntax errors as diagnostics.
config.diagnostics.delay: Milliseconds to debounce parser diagnostics after editing.
